title: Reviewer-handoff template (sign-off recorded in PR)
context: Reviewer sign-offs must be recorded in the pull request in a consistent, auditable form so that delivery can confirm every required gate passed. The handoff template structures that record. It depends on the reviewer checklist.
objective: Create the reviewer-handoff template that records sign-offs, COI, and tier-specific gate completion in the PR.
acceptanceCriteria: Template captures reviewer identity, qualification tier, COI declaration, and independence from drafting
Records per-tier gate completion: second reviewer (Tier B/C), back-translation (Tier C), clinician sign-off (medical-critical Tier C)
Links to the pack's review.yaml and lists any unresolved agentFlags as blocking
Designed to be pasted/recorded directly in the PR as the sign-off of record
